About Beeancy

Travel marketing, from the inside.

Beeancy is a London-based marketing agency built by people who know the travel industry first-hand — how trips are dreamed up, researched, compared and finally booked. We put that insider knowledge to work for travel brands worldwide.

Why we exist

Most agencies treat travel like any other vertical: same funnels, same stock imagery, same claims. But travel isn't bought like a product. There are booking windows and shoulder seasons. Months of dreaming before a single click. Enquiries that mature over weeks, not minutes.

We built Beeancy because marketing that ignores those rhythms wastes money — and because AI, used honestly, changes what a small senior team can deliver. Our travel marketing experts create every idea, design and campaign. AI handles the research and admin underneath. The result: senior thinking at modern speed.

We don't publish numbers we can't prove. We'd rather earn trust with the work.

How we think

Three principles behind every engagement.

✈

Travel first

Every strategy starts with the traveller's journey — from the first daydream to the booking confirmation — and the seasonality that shapes it.

✦

Humans lead, AI accelerates

Ideas, design and judgement are human. Research, analysis and admin are AI-assisted. We never ship work no one thought about.

◎

Prove it or don't say it

Claims we can't stand behind don't go on our site or yours. Reporting is honest, and bad news travels to you as fast as good.
